relation: fixed actors exchange an ordered request and response sequence while each message remains attributable to one sender and one receiver

stageEvents.observable: three actors occupy fixed columns with persistent lifelines
the client request travels to the API as the first event
the API request reaches the database only after the first request arrives
the database result returns through the API in two ordered response events
all four messages remain readable from top to bottom as one completed exchange

limits: two to four fixed actors arranged in one declared order
each message has exactly one sender, one receiver, one kind, and one sequence index
message sequence indices are unique and contiguous
a response follows the request that enables it
actors and lifelines do not swap positions during the exchange
no parallel fork, join barrier, condition branch, state transition, free-form chat, or causal feedback claim
